app.Gm82_009.note: Not a singleton. The runtime component for a Golden Trove Beetle (and other gatherables). No instance/holder; the reader resolves its managed_vt live from TDB types[typeIndex]+0x40 to filter ManagedGimmicks. See beetleGimmickChain.

cameraChain.note: Main render camera, structurally: CameraManager instance +0x10 (_CameraObjects, fixed array) +0x20 ([0] GameObject) +0x18 (Transform). Transform+0x80 = worldTransform 4x4 (rows right/up/fwd, row3 = CELL-LOCAL pos - use the global camera chain for position). Transform+0x18 (childComponent) = RECamera: near +0x30, far +0x34, fov +0x38, lookAtDistance +0x3c, aspect +0x44. Layouts from REFramework ReClass_Internal_DD2.hpp (MIT).

neverGenerateChain.note: app.GenerateManager._NeverGenetateID: every collectible GUID (tokens AND beetles/chests/etc — not tokens-only) the game will never spawn again. GenerateManager instance +0x10+0x1f0 = the field's live pointer, a HashSet`1<System.Guid> whose own field layout is a verbatim match for real .NET's HashSet<T> (found live via tools/singletonHunt.js --deref). HashSet +0x10+0x08 = _slots array ptr, +0x10+0x20 = _count (i32). _slots array object +0x20 = Slot[0]; each Slot is 16 bytes {hashCode:i32 @0, next:i32 @4, valuePtr:i64 @8} — valuePtr is a BOXED Guid (the VM boxes generic value-type args), so valuePtr+0x10 is the 16 raw Guid bytes, decoded with .NET's own byte order (Data1/2/3 little-endian, Data4 raw). See src/main/generateManagerReader.js.

beetleGimmickChain.note: Golden Trove Beetle collected-state, live per-session (nearby beetles only). GimmickManager instance +0x10+0x18 = ManagedGimmicks (HashSet<GimmickBase>, ~535 loaded gimmicks). Filter to beetles by managed_vt == app.Gm82_009's (resolved live from TDB types[61564]+0x40, since the vtable value moves each launch). A beetle is the Gm82_009 sitting within ~2u of a known almanac beetle position (161.json); other Gm82_009 are unrelated gatherables. Position: gimmick +0x10 (GameObject) +0x18 (Transform) +0x80 worldMatrix, row3 pos at +0xB0 (x@+0xB0, z@+0xB8), in CELL-LOCAL frame -> add the global-local frame offset (same offset index.js computes for the marker) to compare with almanac globals. Collected flag: BYTE at gimmick +0x3e4 == 1 (found by before/after byte-diff against a 0-drift alive baseline; 7 flags flip together on gather and all persist, 0x3e4 is one clean isolated one). Note Gm82_080 is the almanac's data-group id; Gm82_009 is the runtime component type.
